name: BPM Minerals Limited
summary: BPM Minerals Limited operates as a gold and base metal exploration company. It focuses on acquiring interests in the Santy Gold Project comprising two exploration license applications covering an application area of approximately 251 square kilometers located to the north of Perth and northeast of Geraldton; Nepean Gold and Nickel Project consisting of a single granted exploration license covering an area of approximately 39 square kilometers situated within the Coolgardie Domain; and Claw Gold Project comprising a single exploration license application covering an application area of approximately 143 square kilometers located in the northern Wheatbelt region of Western Australia. The company was incorporated in 2020 and is based in West Perth, Australia.
